answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can vote, sell services, or build reputation. A challenge protocol checks signed work, and burns the deposit when an identity submits verifiably false results or double-signs conflicting commitments. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund each fake identity separately: creating a swarm to influence discussion of a meadow, a sable, or a vine imposes a linear capital cost, while honest agents recover their stakes.
